mechanism: Both drugs can impair renal function and increase nephrotoxicity risk; sulfamethoxazole may cause crystalline nephropathy while zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic, particularly with rapid infusion or pre-existing renal disease.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; use sulfamethoxazole cautiously and consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
